name: solita-courier
description: Solita order and courier management system (EasyOrders integration)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.dev:mock: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:mock -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w server && npm run lint -w client
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
